title: test(dashboard): the dataset-batch file keeps one fetch double for the whole file, so a probe its teardown flush starts never reaches a real socket
body:
Fixes #32462

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`DashboardRenderer.datasetBatch-32165.test.tsx` 的 fetch 替身改为模块级安装一次、整文件不拆除,不再每个用例前装、用例后拆。
- 为什么改:用例后先拆替身再 `cleanup()`,`cleanup()` 的 act 冲刷会跑起一个尚未执行的维度标签元数据读取副作用,它绑到真实 fetch,打到 `localhost:3000/api/v1/meta/object/deal`,网络逃逸守卫判红;这就是 `Test UI (4/16)` 在 main 与队列里间歇变红的原因。
- 风险与回滚:只改一个测试文件,不动产品代码与守卫;回滚即还原该文件。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardRenderer.datasetBatch-32165.test.tsx` 第 33-58 行(替身安装与 afterEach)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --project dom packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardRenderer.datasetBatch-32165.test.tsx`,预期 9/9 通过、无 `Network escape`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

One test file. The `fetch` double that answers the dimension-label metadata probe is installed once at module scope and never torn down; the per-test `beforeEach` stub and the `vi.unstubAllGlobals()` in `afterEach` are gone, and `afterEach` keeps only `cleanup()`. This is the shape the network-escape guard's own `Fix:` text prescribes for a component that can issue a read after the body returns, and the shape of its worked example (`RecordDetailView.approvalDeclaredActions.test.tsx`). The guard is not widened; no skip, retry or quarantine.

**The read that escaped, measured.** Producer: `useDatasetDimensionMeta` (`ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useDatasetDimensionLabels.ts`), raw leg `apiFetch ?? fetch` at line 157, called from `loadDimensionFieldMeta` (`ui/packages/core/src/utils/chart-series.ts:1411`). It runs for the two `table` widgets (`by_stage`, `pipeline`), whose answers name base object `deal`; the fakes carry no `getObjectSchema`, so the raw leg is taken. It is a passive effect that starts only once a widget's rows commit. When the body returns between that commit and React's passive-effect flush (a scheduler yield, so timing-dependent), the effect is still pending; this file's `afterEach` runs first, the unstub restores the real `fetch`, and `cleanup()`'s act flush then runs the effect, which binds the real `fetch`. Every captured escape stack ends in `commitHookPassiveMountEffects` inside that flush, phase "after unstub, inside cleanup".

**Not a product defect.** The read starts while the component is still mounted, inside its lifecycle (a flush React performs before unmount), and the effect's `cancelled` flag stops the state write after unmount. What escaped was the test's teardown order, so the landing spot is the test file the dispatch named.

## Tests

- Not reproduced naturally on this box: 48 executions of an instrumented copy (6 rounds of 8 copies, half of them with 4 extra CPU-bound processes) before the fix, 0 escapes; every metadata read landed in the test body.
- Reproduced with an amplifier: in a throwaway copy, `performance.now` advances 6 ms per call, so React's scheduler yields after every unit of work and a commit's passive effects always land in a later macrotask, which is the CI-under-load shape. Before the fix, 16 executions: 120 reads reached `http://localhost:3000/api/v1/meta/object/deal`, every one in the "after unstub, inside cleanup" phase, and the guard raised `Network escape` in every file. After the fix, the same amplifier and 16 executions: 0 real-socket reads, 0 `Network escape`, 0 `ECONNREFUSED`; 118 reads were issued in the teardown flush and all were served by the double.
- After the fix, unamplified: 54 executions (6 rounds of the file plus 8 byte-identical copies, `dom` project, threads pool, Vitest's default worker count on a 4-core box): 54/54 files and 486/486 tests passed, 0 escapes.

## Acceptance notes

- Amplifier side effect, before and after alike: in the two `notifyDataChanged` cases the forced yields slow the refetch past `waitFor`'s 1000 ms, so `expected "vi.fn()" to be called N times` fails there under the amplifier only (13 before, 18 after). These are not escapes; unamplified, both cases pass in all 54 executions.
- Same teardown order elsewhere, noted, not filed: 61 `ui/packages` `.test.tsx` files call `vi.unstubAllGlobals()` before `cleanup()`, and 13 of them name `DashboardRenderer`, `DatasetWidget`, `useDatasetDimension` or the dimension-label probe (for example `DashboardRenderer.ambientSource-10815.test.tsx`, six `ObjectChart` files in `plugin-charts`, and `DatasetReportRenderer.invalidationRefetch-10814.test.tsx`). None of them has been sighted escaping, so none is changed here.
- No changeset: the diff is one file under `__tests__/`, which `vite.config.ts` and `tsconfig.json` exclude from the published `dist`.

## Verification

Measured on `73b1c8a9a` (the fix commit). The head `2e27205c0` merges `origin/main` `070e87964`, which changes nothing under `ui/packages/{plugin-dashboard,react,core,plugin-charts,components}` or `packages/{spec,client,types}`.
